name: @velm/desktop
description: Velm local desktop app (Electron) — Canvas LMS & StudentVUE dashboard with zero cloud servers

scripts.start: pnpm --filter @velm/web build && pnpm run build && electron .
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm --filter @velm/web build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: pnpm --filter @velm/web build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm --filter @velm/web build && pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml
